reviews.title: This App Never Improves
reviews.text:
It just gets more annoying. An example… why, each morning, does the app insist on reloading to the current day’s paper rather than keeping the edition I was in the middle of reading?!

But wait, now we made it take forever for the archive to load. The level incompetence with this app’s development is unreal. Just awful.

reviews.title: Lousy paper
reviews.text:
I wish your paper was like when I first subscribed about 50 years ago when your reporting was balanced 
Now it’s way too liberal and seems like a subsidiary of the Democratic Party, the worlds largest criminal organization
Always follow the money
I hope you guys are at least getting your share of the illegal money

reviews.title: Freezing Up Multiple Times Since Last Update
reviews.text: App has frozen multiple times since last update.  Scrolling seizes up and forces you to close app completely and restart.  Needs updating or review.

reviews.title: Spam
reviews.text: The app constantly spams your phone with alerts. When you click to read one it gives no preview and gives you a sales pitch to subscribe. Don’t use unless you already subscribe
